verdict.summary: AI Gateway 2.0 reaching production-supported general availability strengthens Kong's position as an enterprise control layer for AI traffic. The investable thesis still depends on unconfirmed ARR, financial quality, dilution, and an IPO that has not been announced.

scorecard.label: Growth & scale
scorecard.note: The working ARR estimate suggests public-company scale, but Kong has not publicly confirmed the current figure.

scorecard.label: Market & AI tailwind
scorecard.note: APIs are control points for AI traffic, governance, security, and monetization.

scorecard.label: Product & position
scorecard.note: AI Gateway 2.0 is now production-supported, with first-class AI and MCP governance that broadens Kong's platform position.

scorecard.label: Financial quality
scorecard.note: Gross margin, net retention, growth rate, free cash flow, and concentration remain undisclosed.

scorecard.label: IPO readiness
scorecard.note: Late-stage funding and scale help; no public filing or announced timetable is confirmed.

catalysts.name: AI connectivity becomes a budget line
catalysts.why: AI Gateway 2.0 gives Kong a production-supported control layer for model, agent, and MCP traffic; adoption and monetization remain to be proven.

catalysts.name: Konnect platform expansion
catalysts.why: The standalone AI Gateway adds dedicated runtime, control-plane, cost, identity, and analytics capabilities that can broaden wallet share.

catalysts.name: OpenMeter integration
catalysts.why: Native usage metering and billing could add a monetization layer for API and AI workloads.

catalysts.name: Enterprise validation
catalysts.why: Six consecutive Gartner Leader placements and named enterprise adoption support credibility.

catalysts.name: Current ARR and growth
catalysts.why: The $300M ARR figure is a user-supplied estimate; the IPO model is highly sensitive to confirmation and growth durability.

catalysts.name: Public-company financials
catalysts.why: Retention, gross margin, free cash flow, customer concentration, and stock compensation will determine the quality of the multiple.

catalysts.name: IPO filing and timing
catalysts.why: There is no confirmed public filing. An S-1 would replace estimates with audited evidence.

catalysts.name: Competitive pressure
catalysts.why: Hyperscalers, Apigee, MuleSoft, Cloudflare, and open-source alternatives can pressure growth and pricing.

milestones.title: ARR passes $100M
milestones.detail: Kong publicly announced that annual recurring revenue had exceeded $100 million.

milestones.title: $175M Series E at $2B
milestones.detail: The up-round combined primary and secondary financing and increased the prior valuation by about 45%.

milestones.title: OpenMeter acquired
milestones.detail: Kong added usage-based metering and billing for API and AI workloads.

milestones.title: Sixth Gartner Leader year
milestones.detail: Kong said Gartner again named it a Leader in API Management and placed it furthest for vision.

milestones.title: AI Connectivity strategy
milestones.detail: Kong emphasized agentic AI, large-enterprise adoption, organizational expansion, and deeper regional investment.

milestones.title: ~$10 secondary reference
milestones.detail: User-reported insider secondary pricing, used only as a comparison marker rather than verified market value.

milestones.title: AI Gateway 2.0 reaches GA
milestones.detail: Kong made its standalone AI Gateway production-supported, adding MCP server bundling, identity-aware controls, modality-aware cost governance, expanded model support, and AWS IAM authentication.

milestones.title: IPO still unconfirmed
milestones.detail: No public IPO filing or company-endorsed timetable was found in the current evidence set.

upgradeRules.detail: Audited growth, margins, retention, share count, and offering terms replace the largest unknowns.
Confirms both scale and durability; multiple still depends on margins and retention.
Supports a premium software multiple when growth and free-cash-flow margin are both credible.
A useful demand signal, but less authoritative than an underwritten IPO or audited filing.
Would challenge the premium-growth valuation case.
The enterprise may still be valuable, but more shares divide that value more ways.
Higher rates or weaker software demand can reduce the multiple even if Kong executes.

changeLog.headline: AI Gateway 2.0 reaches GA
changeLog.detail: Raised Product & position by one point because Kong moved its standalone AI Gateway from beta to production-supported GA. ARR, multiple, cash, dilution, and IPO-discount assumptions are unchanged because the release disclosed no adoption, bookings, revenue, or margin evidence.

changeLog.headline: Initial thesis baseline
changeLog.detail: Constructive on scale, AI/API demand, and platform breadth; confidence capped by private-company disclosure and no confirmed filing.
